europe_now.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges disrupt water and power
europe_now.summary: Russian forces attacked two key bridges in Kyiv, causing widespread disruptions to heating, water, and electricity supplies. The strikes targeted critical civilian infrastructure in the Ukrainian capital.

europe_now.title: Ukrainian drones damage Crimea Bridge in major attack
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian drones struck the strategic Crimea Bridge, a vital supply route for Russian forces in the occupied peninsula. The attack represents a significant escalation in the targeting of key infrastructure.

top_stories.title: Five EU countries advance Rwanda migrant return plan
top_stories.summary: Five EU member states have announced a partnership with Rwanda to establish a hub for deporting failed asylum seekers. No formal agreement has been reached and key operational details remain undisclosed.

top_stories.title: EU imposes new sanctions on Russian hackers and propagandists
top_stories.summary: The European Union has sanctioned individuals and entities linked to Russian disinformation campaigns and cyber operations targeting voters. The measures address thousands of fake accounts used to manipulate public opinion.

top_stories.title: Mass protests in Czech Republic against government media overhaul
top_stories.summary: Large demonstrations have taken place in the Czech Republic opposing a government plan to restructure public media funding. Protesters warn the changes would undermine media independence and democratic safeguards.
